headline: Tk 1.21 crore robbed from Uttara fuel pump near Dhaka airport
summary: Gunmen intercepted a van carrying cash and fled with a massive sum from a pump owned by the Prime Minister's cousin.
details: Gunmen robbed Tk 1.21 crore from a fuel pump in Uttara, Dhaka, during broad daylight.
The robbers intercepted a van carrying the cash near the Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport area.
The fuel pump is reportedly owned by a cousin of the Prime Minister.
The criminals fled the scene immediately after seizing the money.
Police are investigating the incident to track down the perpetrators.
caption:
Tk 1.21 crore stolen in broad daylight! Gunmen targeted a fuel pump's cash van near Dhaka airport.

Gunmen robbed Tk 1.21 crore from a fuel pump in Uttara, Dhaka, during broad daylight.

The robbers intercepted a van carrying the cash near the Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport area.

The fuel pump is reportedly owned by a cousin of the Prime Minister.

The criminals fled the scene immediately after seizing the money.

Police are investigating the incident to track down the perpetrators.

headline_marked: [[PM greets son of disappeared BNP leader]] on SSC success
headline: PM greets son of disappeared BNP leader on SSC success
summary: The Prime Minister sent greetings to the son of a disappeared BNP leader after he achieved success in the SSC examinations.
details: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has extended her greetings to the son of a disappeared BNP leader following his success in the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examinations.
The student, identified as the son of a leader who went missing, received the Prime Minister's congratulations for his academic achievement.
The gesture comes as a point of recognition for the student's hard work and success despite the challenging circumstances surrounding his family's situation.
The news of the student's success and the subsequent greeting from the Prime Minister was reported by several national media outlets.
caption:
A moment of recognition: The Prime Minister greets the son of a disappeared BNP leader on his SSC success.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has extended her greetings to the son of a disappeared BNP leader following his success in the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examinations.

The student, identified as the son of a leader who went missing, received the Prime Minister's congratulations for his academic achievement.

The gesture comes as a point of recognition for the student's hard work and success despite the challenging circumstances surrounding his family's situation.

The news of the student's success and the subsequent greeting from the Prime Minister was reported by several national media outlets.
